module subtract_8bit (
    input signed [7:0] a, b,
    output signed [8:0] diff
);

    wire signed [7:0] b_complement = ~b + 1; // Compute two's complement of b
    wire signed [8:0] sum = a + b_complement; // Add a and b_complement as signed

    assign diff = sum[8] ? ~sum[7:0] : sum[7:0]; // Adjust to 9-bit signed

endmodule

module comparator_4bit(
    input [3:0] A,   // First 4-bit input operand
    input [3:0] B,   // Second 4-bit input operand
    output A_greater, 
    output A_equal,   
    output A_less     
);

    wire [3:0] eq_bits = ~(A ^ B); // XOR each bit and invert to check equality
    wire [3:0] gt_bits = A & ~B;   // Bits where A is 1 and B is 0 (A > B)
    wire [3:0] slt_bits = ~A & B;  // Bits where A is 0 and B is 1 (A < B)

    assign A_greater = |gt_bits;    // OR all gt_bits to determine A > B
    assign A_equal = &eq_bits;      // AND all eq_bits to determine A == B
    assign A_less = |slt_bits;      // OR all slt_bits to determine A < B

endmodule
